items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a morphism of sites and a morphism between objects there is a commutative diagram of localized topoi, with the induced morphism written as a composite of a localization of the morphism of sites and a relocalization, and with an explicit description of its pullback (statement lines 6659-6711). The proof is a complete derivation: the commutativity of the first square follows by combining the two relevant commutative diagrams (proof lines 6714-6719); the description of the pullback is obtained by combining the two available descriptions (proof lines 6720-6723); and the last square follows from a displayed identity of fibre products, which the author notes is formal using the identifications of pullbacks of representable sheaves (proof lines 6724-6734). The non-formal content is the combination of the two descriptions. The claim is H2: a structured derivation with each input named.
